versions.changelog:
- Initial release of topic-to-video skill: automatically turns any topic or slide deck into a narrated explainer short video.
- Accepts a topic, .pptx, .pdf, image folder, or slide-maker hand-off as input; supports any language and cross-language voicing.
- Automatically researches the topic, writes and voices the script, designs visuals, burns captions, and outputs in cinematic Remotion or HTML tiers.
- Includes free TTS (Edge-TTS + ffmpeg) with optional cloud TTS; outputs editable storyboard and provides a sample for sign-off before rendering full video.
- Robust pipeline with detailed controls for timing, mastering, scene pauses, palette/theme derivation, and design DNA extraction from slides.
